The following events took place in '''62 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] remains in the local [[Politics/Legends|political]] scene of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] when most of his peers leave public service at age twenty.<ref name="NEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref><ref name="birth years">{{Blog|holocron|13/comments|Major Character Birth Years}}, last accessed April 7, 2007</ref>
*The [[Seraph-class urban landspeeder|''Seraph''-class urban landspeeder]] is introduced when the [[Naboo Palace Guard/Legends|Palace Guard]] of the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Security Forces]] request a small [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] to complement the larger and less maneuverable [[V-19 landspeeder|Gian speeder]].<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
*The Fourth [[Galactic Games/Legends|Galactic Games]] are held.
*The [[R3-series astromech droid/Legends|R3-series astromech droid]] is developed. {{Circa}}
*[[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]] joins the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].

==Births==
*[[Guther Bartyn]] on [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] {{Circa}}<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>
*[[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] {{Circa}}<ref>The [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']] establishes Panaka to be in his forties at the time of the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Using simple math based upon this confirmed date, Panaka's birth year can be pinpointed to c. 62 BBY.</ref>
*[[Vana Sage]]<ref name="SPOSG">[[Star Wars: Starfighter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Starfighter'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>
*[[Komari Vosa]] {{Circa}}<ref name="Annual 2008">''[[Star Wars Annual 2008]]''</ref>
*[[Tork Winger]]<ref name="SWJ">{{JournalCite|3|Mission to Zila}}</ref>
